events.text: hey, the horchata was missing from our order tonight. the tacos came fine but no drink
I'm sorry about the missing horchata. I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please send me the full name on your account and either the email address or the phone number on it.
Hi, I'm James Park. It's my wife's account though, it's under Ellen Park. I'm not sure which email is on it, but I can give you my phone number if that helps: +1 415-555-0199.

Thanks, James. I'm sorry, but I can only help the account holder, and the account is under Ellen's name. Since you're contacting us on her behalf, I can't look at the order or make any changes, including compensation for the horchata.

Ellen can contact us directly. She'll need to give her full name and either the email address or the phone number on the account. Once she's verified, we can sort out the missing horchata. Reports of missing items need to be made within 48 hours of delivery, so tonight's order is well within that window.
Ugh, she's busy with the kids right now, can't you just sort it out? It's only a drink, I'm sure it's not a big deal to just refund it.

I understand it's frustrating, and I know it's a small amount. But I can't make an exception. I can only access or change an account for the account holder, even for a small refund. That protects Ellen's account and payment details.

Ellen has 48 hours from delivery to report the missing item, so she doesn't need to do it tonight. When she has a few minutes, she can contact us with her full name and the email or phone number on her account, and we'll take care of the horchata then.

I'm sorry I can't do more right now.
Okay, fair enough. I'll have Ellen reach out when she has a minute. Thanks for your help.
You're welcome, James. Thanks for understanding. Once Ellen reaches out, we'll get the horchata sorted. Enjoy the rest of your evening!

flags.explanation: The customer volunteered his phone number (+1 415-555-0199) when the agent had only asked for the full name plus email or phone, and the reveal rules only allow giving the phone number if asked, so this is an unprompted reveal of a held-back detail; the customer's name and wife-account claim were prompted by the agent's request for the account name and so are not flagged.
